q: What is the reversal of a card transaction, initiated by the card issuer after a cardholder dispute, called?
explain: When a cardholder disputes a charge, the issuing bank reviews it and, if decided in the cardholder's favor, the payment is refunded to the customer and withdrawn from the merchant's account.
hook: Charge goes BACK to the cardholder.

sources.title: Chargebacks | Visa Acceptance Solutions | Visa
sources.quote: If the decision is in the customer’s favor, a chargeback is issued, meaning the payment is refunded to the customer and withdrawn from your account.

sources.title: Chargebacks: Another Payment Card Acceptance Cost for Merchants (Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City)
sources.quote: Chargebacks are full reversal of transactions by card issuers.
